existing_approved_printer.title: Clear Print Queue - Guide 1
existing_approved_printer.content: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again.

retain_article.title: Printer queue recovery: preserve existing settings
retain_article.content: For a printer queue that is stuck and print jobs that will not clear, KEEP all existing printer settings unchanged. Stop the print spooler, clear the stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and retry printing. Do NOT reset printer settings.

reset_article.title: Printer queue recovery: restore factory settings
reset_article.content: For a printer queue that is stuck and print jobs that will not clear, RESET the printer settings to factory defaults before attempting to print again. Do NOT retain the existing printer settings.
